description: This file contains validation rules and utility functions for form validation in a TypeScript-based web application, including date, time, number, file, and string validations, as well as external dependencies for date handling and internationalization.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Validates that the provided value is not empty, null, or invalid based on its type (string, number, array, object).

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Creates a validator to ensure a string does not exceed a specified character length.

methods.name: validDateFormat
methods.description: Checks if a given date string matches the specified date format.

methods.name: shouldBeCurrentOrPreviousDate
methods.description: Validates that a date is not in the future.

methods.name: validTimeFormat
methods.description: Validates that a time string is in a proper time format (HH:mm).

methods.name: max
methods.description: Creates a validator to ensure a number does not exceed a maximum value.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only digits.

methods.name: numericOnly
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only numeric digits.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPoint
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid decimal number with optional decimal point.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPointAndMinusSign
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid decimal number with optional decimal point and minus sign.

methods.name: beforeDate
methods.description: Determines if one date is before another date.

methods.name: afterDate
methods.description: Determines if one date is after another date.

methods.name: sameDate
methods.description: Checks if two dates are the same.

methods.name: endDateShouldBeAfterStartDate
methods.description: Validates that an end date is after a start date, with options for equality.

methods.name: beforeTime
methods.description: Checks if one time is before another time.

methods.name: afterTime
methods.description: Checks if one time is after another time.

methods.name: sameTime
methods.description: Checks if two times are the same.

methods.name: endTimeShouldBeAfterStartTime
methods.description: Ensures an end time is after a start time, with optional allowance for equality.

methods.name: maxFileSize
methods.description: Validator to check maximum file size in bytes.

methods.name: validFileTypes
methods.description: Validator to check if a file's type is in a list of allowed types.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates email address format.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates phone number format allowing digits and common separators.

methods.name: startDateShouldBeBeforeEndDate
methods.description: Checks if a start date is before an end date, with options for equality.

methods.name: maxCurrency
methods.description: Ensures a numeric value is less than a maximum currency value.

methods.name: startTimeShouldBeBeforeEndTime
methods.description: Validates that start time is before end time.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Ensures that a string has a minimum character length.

methods.name: maxValueShouldBeGreaterThanMinValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is greater than a specified minimum.

methods.name: minValueShouldBeLowerThanMaxValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is less than a specified maximum.

methods.name: numberShouldBeBetweenMinAndMaxValue
methods.description: Validates that a number is within a specified range.

methods.name: validHexFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string is a valid hexadecimal color code.

methods.name: imageShouldHaveDimensions
methods.description: Checks if an image has dimensions that match a specified aspect ratio within a tolerance.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Validator to check if a number is greater than or equal to a minimum value.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Validator to check if a number is less than or equal to a maximum value.

methods.name: validLangString
methods.description: Validates language strings for balanced braces.

methods.name: validSelection
methods.description: Ensures that the selection is not an invalid string or object.

methods.name: validHostnameFormat
methods.description: Validates if a hostname or IP address string matches expected formats.

methods.name: validPortRange
methods.description: Validates if a port number is within a specified range and length.

methods.name: validVideoURL
methods.description: Validates if a URL is a valid YouTube video URL.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithTwoDecimalPoints
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid number with up to two decimal points.

ctags.name: digitsOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const digitsOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: lessThanOrEqual
ctags.pattern: /^export const lessThanOrEqual = function (maxValue: number, message?: string) {$/

ctags.name: numericOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const numericOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export const validEmailFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validHostnameFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validHostnameFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validSelection
ctags.pattern: /^export const validSelection = function (value: string | object | null) {$/

ctags.name: validTimeFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validTimeFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export const validVideoURL = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/
